title: Cuspidated
summary: CUSPIDATE, CUSPIDATED adjective [Latin , a point.] Having a sharp end, like the point of a spear; terminating in a bristly point; as a cuspidate leaf.

inlines.v: CUSPIDATE, CUSPIDATED adjective [Latin , a point.] Having a sharp end, like the point of a spear; terminating in a bristly point; as a cuspidate leaf.
